title: HWG7 U04 — A Day with the Elves
style: Japanese anime cel-shaded style matching the attached character sheets: clean confident line art, flat cel shading with soft gradients, cinematic TV-anime key-visual finish, cozy sci-fi winter world with rich warm and cool lighting. 16:9 landscape film frame. Characters keep their mouths gently closed. The image contains no writing of any kind: no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermark, no speech bubbles.

chars.teddy: Teddy (a 10-year-old boy with black bowl-cut hair and straight bangs, big brown eyes, cream hooded puffer jacket with two thin brown stripes across the chest, dark brown snow pants, white snow boots, brown mittens)
chars.amber: Amber (a 10-year-old girl with long light-brown hair, round red-framed glasses, red Santa hat with white trim, pale yellow knit scarf, light-blue sweater, blue jeans, navy snow boots)
chars.abu: Abu (a small white robot child: round glossy white head with a small bear-like snout and black nose, black oval eyes, light-blue headphone-like ear modules, glowing light-blue heart on the chest, light-blue joint rings, red knitted scarf)
chars.joy: Joy (a small girl elf: red pointed elf hat with a plain red band, two long brown braids, pointed ears, white shirt under a red vest with white trim, white shorts, red-and-green striped stockings, red curled shoes)
chars.alan: Alan (a small boy elf: red pointed elf hat with a plain red band, short brown hair, pointed ears, round chubby face, white shirt under a red vest with white trim, white shorts, red-and-green striped stockings, red curled shoes)
chars.santa: Santa Claus (a jolly old man with a big fluffy white beard and mustache, rosy round cheeks, red Santa hat with a white pompom)

masters.field: Wide empty snowy Finnish landscape at night under vivid green and violet Northern Lights in a starry sky, snow-covered pine trees, gentle white hills. In the middle ground stands a futuristic sled with smooth white curves, soft cyan glowing light strips and a cozy padded seat with a brown blanket, harnessed to two friendly brown reindeer with softly glowing blue harness lights. No people.
masters.classroom: Interior of a cozy sci-fi elf school classroom inside a wooden log cabin: warm wooden walls, several round red mushroom-shaped stools on a wooden floor, a low wooden stage at the front with a teacher's wooden desk and a globe, a large blank softly glowing cyan holographic panel on the back wall with nothing on it, shelves with a toy sailboat and books, big windows on the left side showing a snowy night with Northern Lights. Warm golden lamp light. No people.
masters.yard: Snowy yard outside a wooden elf school cabin at blue twilight: soft deep snow, snow-covered pine trees, a half-built snowman made of two big snowballs next to a small wooden stool, a little basket of black coal stones, a few glowing sci-fi lanterns on posts. No people.
masters.workshop: Interior of a warm elf gift workshop: long wooden worktables covered with colorful wrapping paper, ribbons, scissors and gift boxes, a gently glowing sci-fi conveyor belt carrying wrapped presents in the background, string lights, snowy windows on the left side. No people.
masters.hotspring: Outdoor night scene in deep snow: on the right a steaming natural hot spring pool framed by dark rocks, on the left a frozen lake with one round hole cut in the ice showing dark water, a small wooden sauna cabin with warm glowing windows in the background, vivid Northern Lights in a starry violet sky. No people.

shots.narr: Teddy, Amber and Abu are in Finland. It's near the North Pole. It's very cold.
shots.frame: Wide shot: Teddy, Amber and Abu sit side by side in the glowing sled under a brown blanket, pulled by the two reindeer across the snow, shivering a little and looking ahead in wonder. Northern Lights fill the sky.
shots.action: The sled glides slowly across the snow; the three friends shiver and look around in wonder. Nobody speaks.

shots.frame: Medium close-up of Teddy sitting in the sled, looking up at the sky with wide eyes, green aurora light reflecting on his face, mouth closed, face clearly visible in three-quarter view.
shots.action: Teddy looks up at the sky, points upward and says his line with excitement.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teddy sits in the sled under the brown blanket and slowly tilts his head back to look up at the sky. His eyes open wide and his eyebrows lift as green light ripples across his face. He pulls his right mittened hand out from under the blanket and points straight up at the Northern Lights, then says his line with excitement while his gaze follows the moving lights from left to right. After the line his mouth closes into a big smile and he keeps pointing upward, shaking the pointing hand twice in delight.

line.text: We are in the Arctic Circle now!

shots.frame: Medium shot: Amber stands in the sled facing the camera with both arms spread wide and a big smile, mouth closed; Abu stands beside her, bouncing happily with both hands raised. Northern Lights behind them.
shots.action: Amber spreads her arms and says her line happily; Abu bounces beside her and does not speak.

line.text: What time do you get up, Joy?

shots.frame: Medium shot: Amber sits on a red mushroom stool and raises her right hand, turning in three-quarter view toward the front of the room on the right, face clearly visible, mouth closed.
shots.action: Amber raises her hand and asks her question, looking toward the front of the classroom.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Amber sits on the red mushroom stool with her right hand already raised. She stretches the raised arm a little higher, leans her upper body slightly forward toward the front of the room on the right, and says her friendly question while tilting her head once to the side. Her glasses catch the warm lamp light as she blinks. After the line her lips close, she keeps her hand up for a moment, then lowers it to her knee and waits with curious, wide eyes and a small smile.

line.text: I get up at seven thirty.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Joy stands on the low wooden stage in front of the teacher's desk, facing the camera, hands clasped, smiling with mouth closed.
shots.action: Joy answers cheerfully, rocking on her heels.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Joy stands on the low wooden stage with her hands clasped in front of her. She rises onto her toes once, rocks back onto her heels, and answers cheerfully toward the camera, her two long braids swinging gently as she nods on the word thirty. Her pointed ears twitch upward when she smiles. After the line her lips close into a proud grin, she unclasps her hands and gives a small wave with her right hand at chest height, then clasps them again.

line.text: What time do you go to school, Alan?

shots.frame: Medium shot: Abu sits on a red mushroom stool and raises one hand, turned in three-quarter view toward the front of the room on the right, his heart glowing, mouth closed.
shots.action: Abu raises his hand and asks his question.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Abu sits on the red mushroom stool with one white robot hand raised. He waves the raised hand twice from side to side, turns his round head slightly toward the front of the room on the right, and asks his polite question while his blue heart pulses brighter on each word. His light-blue ear modules glow softly. After the line his mouth closes, he lowers the hand to his lap and tilts his head to one side, waiting for the answer with big shining eyes.

line.text: I go to school at eight o'clock.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Alan stands on the low wooden stage beside the teacher's desk, facing the camera with his hands on his hips, smiling with mouth closed.
shots.action: Alan answers proudly with his hands on his hips.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Alan stands on the low wooden stage beside the teacher's desk with his hands on his hips. He puffs out his chest, bounces once on his curled red shoes, and answers proudly toward the camera, nodding firmly on the words eight o'clock. His round cheeks lift in a wide grin and his pointed ears wiggle. After the line his lips close, he keeps his hands on his hips, rocks from side to side once and gives a quick satisfied nod.

line.text: What do you do in your free time?

shots.frame: Medium close-up: Teddy sits on a red mushroom stool, leaning forward curiously, three-quarter view toward the right, face clearly visible, mouth closed.
shots.action: Teddy leans forward and asks his question with curiosity.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teddy sits on the red mushroom stool and leans his upper body further forward, resting both mittened hands on his knees. His eyebrows rise and his eyes widen with curiosity as he asks his question toward the front of the room on the right, tilting his head slightly at the end of the sentence. After the line his lips close, he sits up straight again, rubs his hands together once and waits with an eager smile, his eyes fixed to the right.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Joy stands on the small wooden stool beside the snowman, one hand still on the snowman's new carrot nose, her body and face turned toward the camera, face fully visible in front view, big smile with mouth closed.
shots.action: Joy puts the carrot nose on the snowman, then turns and says her line.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Alan sits cross-legged on a cushion by the classroom window, a floating cyan holographic screen in front of him showing only colorful abstract shapes and simple picture icons, his face lit in cyan, three-quarter view toward the camera, mouth closed.
shots.action: Alan swipes the floating screen with one finger and says his line happily.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Alan sits cross-legged on the cushion in front of the floating cyan holographic screen. He lifts his right index finger and swipes across the screen from right to left twice, and the colorful shapes and picture icons slide along with his finger. He turns his face toward the camera, grins and says his line cheerfully, raising his eyebrows on the last word. After the line his lips close, he winks once and taps one icon on the screen with his finger, making it glow brighter.

shots.narr: Abu, Teddy, and Amber are at the elf school. They wrap gifts.
shots.frame: Wide shot: Teddy, Amber and Abu stand around a worktable wrapping colorful gift boxes with paper and ribbons, smiling, presents moving on the glowing conveyor belt behind them.
shots.action: The camera stays still on the wide shot. Exactly three characters are in the shot the whole time: Teddy on the left, Amber in the middle and Abu on the right; nobody else appears. They fold wrapping paper and tie ribbons around gifts. Nobody speaks.

line.text: What time does Santa have lunch?

shots.frame: Medium shot: Amber stands at the worktable tying a red ribbon on a gift box and looks up toward the right in three-quarter view, face clearly visible, mouth closed.
shots.action: Amber finishes tying the ribbon, looks up and asks her question.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Amber stands at the worktable holding the two ends of a red ribbon around a gift box. She pulls the ribbon tight with both hands and ties a quick bow, then lifts her head and looks up toward the right. She asks her curious question while her hands stay on the finished bow, raising her eyebrows on the word lunch. After the line her lips close, she gives the bow a small pat with her right hand and waits with a curious smile.

line.text: He has lunch at one o'clock.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Joy stands at the worktable wrapping a gift in green paper, facing the camera, smiling with mouth closed.
shots.action: Joy keeps wrapping the gift and answers cheerfully.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Joy stands at the worktable folding green wrapping paper around a gift box. She presses the folded edge down with both palms, slides a strip of tape across it with her right hand, and answers cheerfully toward the camera without stopping her work. She nods once on the words one o'clock and her braids bounce. After the line her lips close into a bright smile, she turns the wrapped box around once on the table and pats its top with both hands.

shots.narr: They are drawing a Christmas card.
shots.frame: Close-up from above of a Christmas card being drawn with colored pencils on a wooden table: the card shows a simple drawing of a decorated Christmas tree with a star. Only two pairs of hands are visible: a boy's hands in brown mittens with cream jacket cuffs, and small white robot hands with light-blue joint rings. No other sleeves or arms, no faces.
shots.action: Hands color the Christmas tree drawing with colored pencils. Nobody speaks.

line.text: What time does Santa go home?

shots.frame: Medium shot: Teddy sits at the worktable holding a colored pencil over a half-drawn Christmas card, looking up toward the right in three-quarter view, face clearly visible, mouth closed.
shots.action: Teddy stops drawing, looks up and asks his question.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teddy sits at the worktable with a colored pencil hovering over the half-drawn Christmas card. He stops drawing, lifts his head and looks up toward the right, tapping the pencil against his chin once as he thinks. Then he asks his question with curious, wide eyes, tilting his head at the end of the sentence. After the line his lips close, he lowers the pencil back to the card and draws one short green line on the tree while glancing up again.

line.text: He goes home at five forty.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Alan holds up a finished Christmas card with a drawing of Santa's sleigh and reindeer, facing the camera, smiling with mouth closed.
shots.action: Alan shows the card proudly and answers.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Alan holds up the finished Christmas card with both hands at chest height. He pushes the card a little toward the camera so the drawing of Santa's sleigh is easy to see, then answers proudly, nodding on the words five forty. His round cheeks lift in a big grin and his pointed ears wiggle. After the line his lips close, he turns the card left and right once to show it off, then hugs it to his chest with a happy squeeze of his shoulders.

shots.narr: The next day... They are going to a hot spring.
shots.frame: Wide shot: Teddy, Amber and Abu walk through the snow toward the steaming hot spring carrying white towels, steam rising, Northern Lights above.
shots.action: The three friends walk happily toward the hot spring. Nobody speaks.

line.text: What time does Santa take a shower?

shots.frame: Medium shot: Abu stands beside the steaming hot spring with a small white towel on his head, three-quarter view, heart glowing, mouth closed.
shots.action: Abu tilts his head and asks his question.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Abu stands beside the steaming hot spring with the small white towel on his head. Steam drifts past him from the right. He tilts his round head to one side so the towel slips a little, lifts one white hand to scratch the side of his head, and asks his puzzled question while his blue heart pulses brighter on each word. After the line his mouth closes, he straightens the towel with both hands and looks toward the frozen lake on the left.

line.text: He takes an ice shower at nine thirty.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Joy stands in the snow near the frozen lake, pointing toward the hole in the ice with one hand, facing the camera with a mischievous smile, mouth closed.
shots.action: Joy points toward the frozen lake and answers with a giggle.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Joy stands in the snow near the frozen lake with her right arm stretched out, pointing at the round hole in the ice. She bends her knees a little, covers a giggle with her left hand for a moment, then says her line with a mischievous smile, jabbing the pointing finger toward the hole twice on the words ice shower. Her braids swing as she laughs. After the line her lips close, she lowers her arm and hugs herself, shivering playfully as if she feels the cold.

shots.frame: Medium shot: Santa Claus sits in the round hole in the frozen lake, only his head, shoulders and arms above the icy water, laughing happily with eyes closed, his red suit and black boots neatly folded on the snow beside the hole.
shots.action: Santa splashes the icy water and laughs heartily without words.

line.text: Ho ho ho! What time do you go to bed, kids?

shots.frame: Medium close-up: Santa Claus sits in the round hole in the frozen lake, head and bare shoulders and arms like a man taking an ice bath (no shirt, no coat, nothing red on his body except his Santa hat), his red suit folded on the snow beside the hole; eyes open and twinkling, raising one bare hand to wave at the camera, mouth closed.
shots.action: Santa waves and asks his question warmly.

line.text: I go to bed at nine o'clock.

shots.frame: Medium close-up: Teddy stands by the hot spring wrapped in a big white towel, looking sleepy with half-closed eyes, mouth closed.
shots.action: Teddy rubs his eye sleepily and answers.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teddy stands by the hot spring wrapped in the big white towel. His eyelids droop and his head nods forward once with sleepiness. He lifts his right mittened hand out of the towel to rub one eye, then answers slowly and sleepily, his shoulders sinking on the words nine o'clock. After the line his lips close, he pulls the towel tighter around his shoulders with both hands, sways gently from side to side once and blinks slowly with heavy eyes.

line.text: It's nine o'clock now. Good night!

shots.frame: Medium close-up: Santa Claus sits in the round hole in the frozen lake, head and bare shoulders and arms like a man taking an ice bath (no shirt, no coat, nothing red on his body except his Santa hat), his red suit folded on the snow beside the hole; he looks at a simple round wristwatch with a plain face on his raised bare wrist, smiling with mouth closed.
shots.action: Santa checks his watch, then winks and says good night.
shots.h3_action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Santa Claus sits in the round hole in the frozen lake with his bare raised wrist showing the plain round watch. He brings the wrist closer to his face, squints at the watch for a moment, then lowers it and looks at the camera. He says his line warmly, smiling under his big white beard, and winks with his right eye on the words good night. After the line his lips close, he gives one slow wave with his raised hand and sinks a little deeper into the icy water.

shots.frame: Wide shot: the glowing sled flies up into the starry sky toward the Northern Lights, pulled by the two reindeer, with Teddy, Amber, Abu, Joy and Alan inside waving happily, the snowy land below.
shots.action: The sled rises into the sky; everyone waves goodbye. Nobody speaks.
